On May 17, 2013, the retrial of George Thomas (with a jury empaneled in Nashville) ended in a verdict of guilty on all 38 counts.
He was re-sentenced to life in prison by the jury, but with the possibility of parole after 51 years.

On June 4, 2013, Judge Kurtz sentenced Thomas to two life sentences (consecutive) for the murders and 25 years (multiple concurrent) for the rapes.[25][113] In 2015, the Tennessee Court of Criminal Appeals upheld Thomas's conviction.[114] In January 2016, Thomas appealed to the United States Supreme Court[115] but the court did not agree to hear the case.
